summary.description: the LLM summary of the old region. The next projection replaces every earlier event with this text.

first_kept_seq.description: the 1-based log sequence of the first event the summary does not cover. Projection replaces every earlier event with the summary. The minimum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer (bin/compact) enforces it, and bin/assemble rejects an unparseable boundary value at read time.

version.description: the 1-based handoff version for this session. Monotonic across all compactions, including across forked branches. The handoff document is written to handoff/v<version>.md so every version is preserved for proof-reading. The minimum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer enforces it.

parent_version.description: the version this handoff diverges from. 0 for the first handoff in a session. The version and this field link the summary to its divergence point, forming the handoff DAG.

diverge_seq.description: the log seq of the parent handoff's first_kept_seq (0 for the first handoff, which summarizes from the start). This is the divergence point where this version's summarized region begins relative to its parent.

reason.description: which trigger fired. The enum keyword is outside the validator subset; the producer (bin/compact) enforces it.

tokens_before.description: the measured input tokens at trigger time.

tokens_after.description: the chars/4 estimate of the post-compaction request. Sources the TUI second number.

read_files.description: file paths the old region's tool calls read. Accumulates across compactions; the next compaction carries the list forward.

modified_files.description: file paths the old region's tool calls modified. Accumulates across compactions; the next compaction carries the list forward.

usage.description: the token usage of the summary call itself. The statusline sums it into the cumulative totals.
